issues.detail: The Greek 'εως ου' (until) is rendered as 'cho đến khi' (until), but the Vietnamese sentence structure 'còn các ngươi, hãy ngồi lại... cho đến khi' implies a command/exhortation ('hãy') that is not present in the Greek. The Greek 'υμεις δε καθισατε' is a statement of fact (you will sit) rather than an imperative command.
